headline: Halcyon reports strong text-to-image results without internet-scale language pretraining
summary: An Oct 19 arXiv preprint introduces Halcyon, early-fusion autoregressive text-to-image models trained from scratch on 100M image-caption pairs. On the authors’ GPIC evaluation, Halcyon-0.52B reports 48.0 gFD against 63.3 for a GPIC-retrained LlamaGen-XL/8 baseline, and Halcyon-1.6B reports 35.3 against 41.0 for a retrained JiT-T2I-XXL/8++ baseline. Their controlled 0.52B experiments report no improvement from external text-only pretraining under tested conditions. The study is author-reported, limited to one dataset and 256x256 images, and does not establish a general rule across model families or image-generation regimes.
